P7476.corridor_notes: Shale-gas connector line (页岩气联络线) linking Ludian County to Zhaoyang District, both in Zhaotong City, Yunnan. EPC contract (four.sichuan Guangran Pipeline Engineering / 四川省广燃管道工程有限责任公司 as EPC contractor, owner 昭通市交通建设投资发展集团有限公司) signed 2023-09-12: DN323.9x8.0 steel pipe, design pressure 6.3 MPa, contracted length 40.11 km, estimated construction cost RMB 120 million, plus new/rebuilt/expanded stations and valve chambers (exact station names/locations not stated in this source). NOTE: contracted length (40.11 km) is notably shorter than the GEM sheet's LengthMergedKm (52.35) for this row -- flagging the discrepancy, not resolving it (could be EPC-scope length vs. full alignment, or a length revision after 2023). The Zhaotong Municipal Ecological Environment Bureau (昭通市生态环境局) accepted the project's EIA filing on 2023-09-27 (listing title confirms both endpoint place names but the detail page, which likely carries the finest route description, could not be reached -- see blockers). Corridor context (NOT confirmed as applying to this specific line, offered only as a lead for a future pass): a separate, unrelated gas-distribution project in the exact same county pair (水富至昭通天然气管道, one-trunk-eight-branch system) documents gas infrastructure at 昭阳区北闸镇 (Beizha Town, Zhaoyang District) and 鲁甸县茨院乡 (Ciyuan Township, Ludian County) -- plausible townships for this shale-gas connector to pass through/terminate near, given they already host distribution stations in the same corridor, but this was not verified for P7476 itself. No other Yunnan GGIT row pairs Ludian County with Zhaoyang District; the nearest analogues are P4511 (Zhanyi District-Zhaoyang District, operating trunk) and P4516 (Yanjin County shale-gas gathering station-Zhaoyang terminal station, proposed) and P4514 (Weixin County-Zhaoyang District, proposed) -- all different source counties, so P7476 is not a duplicate of any existing row.
P7476.researcher_notes: Verified the sheet's pre-existing archive.org candidate ref (https://archive.org/details/2025-07-23-2.29.50): it is a screenshot of the cover page of an EIA-adjacent project report titled '昭阳至鲁甸页岩气联络线工程项目报告书' (Zhaoyang-Ludian Shale Gas Connecting Line Engineering Project Report) -- confirms project existence/name/scope but carries no route geometry or station-level detail (it's an image of a title page, not the report body). Independently corroborated via a second, unrelated source: www.scgrgd.com (EPC contractor's own company-news page reporting the September 2023 contract award), which supplies pipe spec/length/pressure/cost/dates. A third source, the Zhaotong Ecological Environment Bureau's public EIA-acceptance listing page (archived via Wayback since the live .gov.cn domain does not resolve from this environment), independently confirms the project name and 2023-09-27 filing-acceptance date. All three are independent of each other (different organizations: an archived report scan, a construction company, a government bureau), satisfying the 2+ independent source bar for the endpoint place-names (county/district) and the pipeline's existence/status as under construction. Endpoint coordinates are county/district-level centroids (matching the GEM sheet's existing StartLocation='Ludian County'/EndLocation='Zhaoyang District'), NOT station or township level -- despite an extensive Chinese-language search ladder (EIA filings, tender/bid announcements, provincial DRC and Zhaotong municipal environment-bureau portals, Yunnan Energy Investment news, eiafans-style forums), no source could be reached that names a specific station, village, or township as the literal pipeline terminus for THIS line. A human drawing the actual route line should treat these coordinates as loose anchors only, and should try to pull the Zhaotong EIA bureau's detail page (nid=519252, see blockers) once it becomes reachable, since Chinese EIA filings typically include a route table with 起点/止点 township-level detail.
P7476.blockers: Could not obtain station/township-level route detail specific to P7476, only county/district-level. The most promising lead -- the Zhaotong Municipal Ecological Environment Bureau's EIA-acceptance detail page for this project (URL pattern: http://sthjj.zt.gov.cn/contentxdetail.php?nid=519252, linked from the listing page dated 2023-09-27) -- is unreachable: the sthjj.zt.gov.cn domain does not resolve via DNS from this environment (NXDOMAIN, consistent with a geo-blocked/China-only-DNS government portal), there is no existing Wayback Machine snapshot of that specific detail-page URL (only the parent listing page at cid=48 is archived, 2023-12-05), and an archive.org 'Save Page Now' request against the live URL failed with HTTP 523 (origin unreachable). Additionally, the session's web-search budget was exhausted mid-task, cutting off planned follow-up queries against eiafans.com, PipeChina/CNPC portals, and Yunnan provincial 发改委 sources that might carry a finer route description. Recommend a future pass retry the zt.gov.cn detail page (it may resolve from a China-based network) or search eiafans.com directly for the EIA report text.
